## 前置讲义摘要（你必须基于这些已建立的认知继续，不要重复，要承接）

### u1-l1 语义分割推理分支

本讲围绕 MaskFormer eval 分支的语义推理路径，拆解四个最小模块：eval 总体流程、semantic_inference 概率融合、后处理先后取舍、OOM 兜底。核心结论：pred_masks 先批级双线性上采样到 padding 尺寸，再逐图还原到原图尺寸，按 SEMANTIC_ON/PANOPTIC_ON/INSTANCE_ON 三开关分发；semantic_inference 以「softmax 去掉 no-object 通道 + mask sigmoid + einsum("qc,qhw->chw")」把 Q 个 per-mask 预测加权融合成 K 张 per-class 概率图，属软预测，argmax 由下游完成；开关 sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference 决定尺寸还原在融合前（物化 Q 张高清 mask，全景/实例分支必需并强制开启）还是后（低分辨率融合省显存，防高清图 OOM）；retry_if_cuda_oom 提供三段降级：直接执行、清缓存重试、搬 CPU 以 float32 关 autocast 重试。关键术语：mask classification 范式、no-object 通道、原图/网络输入/padding 三种尺寸、sem_seg 概率图。
### u1-l2 环境搭建与 MSDeformAttn CUDA 算子编译

本讲覆盖环境搭建与 MSDeformAttn CUDA 算子编译：Mask2Former 是 detectron2 插件项目，依赖按“PyTorch→detectron2→requirements.txt 及评估库→CUDA 扩展”四层金字塔自底向上安装。核心结论：ops/setup.py 的 CppExtension 分支是死代码，任何成功构建都走 CUDAExtension 并定义 WITH_CUDA 宏，因此无 GPU 机器也必须安装 CUDA toolkit，用 FORCE_CUDA=1 与 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST（指定计算能力）完成编译。CPU 推理回退发生在 Python 层 try/except：C++ 分发层对 CPU 张量抛错后由参考实现 ms_deform_attn_core_pytorch 接管，src/cpu 实现被编译但从不被调用。关键术语：CUDA_HOME、计算能力、MultiScaleDeformableAttention 扩展。
### u1-l3 仓库结构：detectron2 插件式项目如何组织

本讲俯瞰 Mask2Former 仓库组织，核心结论：它是 detectron2 插件式项目——引擎（配置系统、训练循环、分布式启动）全在宿主框架，仓库只含图像版包 mask2former、视频版包 mask2former_video、入口脚本 train_net.py / train_net_video.py、configs 配置库与 datasets 预处理脚本；根目录无 setup.py，源码原地使用。关键机制「import 即注册」：import 包即触发模块顶层语句，装饰器将 MaskFormer、D2SwinTransformer 等登记进 META_ARCH_REGISTRY、SEM_SEG_HEADS_REGISTRY、BACKBONE_REGISTRY 及项目自建 TRANSFORMER_DECODER_REGISTRY，数据集登记进 DatasetCatalog；漏 import 即报 Cannot find object。视频包是不引图像包的薄层，仅重写顶层模型、解码器、匹配损失与数据管线，复用靠入口脚本同时 import 两包。入口脚本三段式：setup 做多层配置叠加（get_cfg→add_deeplab_config→add_maskformer2_config→yaml→命令行，视频版再叠 add_maskformer2_video_config）、Trainer 子类覆写 build_* 方法接插件组件、launch 统一单多卡训练评估路径。
### u1-l4 跑通第一个推理 Demo

本讲以 demo/demo.py 为入口，把模型当黑盒跑通全景分割推理（含 CPU）。核心链路：setup_cfg 组装配置 → VisualizationDemo 构建预测器 → run_on_image 推理并可视化。关键结论：配置是五层叠加（get_cfg、add_deeplab_config、add_maskformer2_config、yaml、命令行 --opts），后写覆盖先写并冻结；yaml 为训练所写，必须用 --opts MODEL.WEIGHTS 指向 MODEL_ZOO 下载的最终 checkpoint。分工口诀：DefaultPredictor（detectron2 提供）管“算”，负责建模型、加载权重、按最短边缩放输入并前向；VisualizationDemo（本仓库）管“画”，从 MetadataCatalog 取类别与颜色，依赖 import mask2former 的注册副作用。推理输出由 SEMANTIC_ON、INSTANCE_ON、PANOPTIC_ON 三个开关决定 sem_seg、instances、panoptic_seg 三个键；run_on_image 的互斥分支使全景存在时不画另两种。常用项：MODEL.DEVICE cpu、INPUT.MIN_SIZE_TEST 提速；--confidence-threshold 是未接线的死参数；OpenCV 读图为 BGR，画图前需反转通道。
### u1-l5 配置系统：add_maskformer2_config 与 yaml 继承

本讲剖析 Mask2Former 配置系统的四个模块：CfgNode 配置树与五层合并顺序、add_maskformer2_config 逐段注册、yaml 的 _BASE_ 继承、两个关键节点与命令行覆盖。核心结论：最终生效配置由 get_cfg() 默认值、add_deeplab_config、add_maskformer2_config、yaml（含 _BASE_ 继承链）、merge_from_list 五层依次叠加，后合并者覆盖先合并者，未注册的键无法覆盖，全部合并完成后才 freeze() 冻结为只读。关键术语与概念：五层叠加、CfgNode 配置树、_BASE_ 按键覆盖式继承（非整棵子树替换，Base 沉淀任务公共项、子文件只写模型差异）、merge_from_list 命令行优先级最高、yaml 可覆盖扩展函数默认值。add_maskformer2_config 是全部 Mask2Former 专属键的唯一注册点，按 INPUT、SOLVER、MODEL.MASK_FORMER、MODEL.SEM_SEG_HEAD 追加键、MODEL.SWIN 与二代新增（解码器名、LSJ、MSDeformAttn、point loss 采样参数）六段组织。MODEL.MASK_FORMER 控制 meta arch 行为（损失权重、query 数、推理任务开关），MODEL.SEM_SEG_HEAD 控制头部与像素解码器，二者分别由 maskformer_model.py 与 mask_former_head.py 的 from_config 消费，构成后续改 backbone、解码器与损失权权的地基。
### u2-l1 训练入口 train_net.py 主流程

本讲拆解训练入口 train_net.py 的四大模块。setup() 按「detectron2 默认值、deeplab 扩展键、Mask2Former 专属键、yaml、命令行」五层顺序合并配置，freeze() 后全进程只读。main() 分两条岔路：--eval-only 以类方法直接评估，不实例化 Trainer；训练分支构造 Trainer、resume_or_load 后启动训练；resume 连优化器状态与迭代数一起恢复，仅加载权重则从零开始。Trainer 继承 detectron2 的 DefaultTrainer，只覆写 build_train_loader、build_optimizer、build_lr_scheduler、build_evaluator 四个类方法，由引擎在构造期与评估期回调，build_model 交给注册表。训练日志的 30 个 loss 键由 DEC_LAYERS=10 的辅助损失机制产生。launch 以 rank、world_size、dist_url 统一单卡、多卡与多机多卡形态，每个进程各自完整执行一遍 setup 与 main。
### u2-l2 数据集注册与准备

本讲讲解 detectron2 的数据集注册机制。核心是双目录分工：`DatasetCatalog` 存「数据集名→惰性加载函数」，`MetadataCatalog` 存「数据集名→静态元数据」；注册不碰磁盘，取数才读盘。「import 即注册」：import mask2former 触发 7 个 register_* 模块顶层执行 register_all_*(root)，根目录由 DETECTRON2_DATASETS 指定。register_* 函数两步：登记惰性 loader 并写元数据（ADE20K 全景：evaluator_type=ade20k_panoptic_seg、ignore_label=255、label_divisor=1000、thing 100 类/stuff 150 类、dataset id→连续 id 映射）。加载函数返回标准 list[dict]，含 pan_seg_file_name、sem_seg_file_name 与带 isthing 标记的 segments_info。prepare_ade20k_pan_seg.py 把官方语义与实例标注合成为 COCO 全景格式，先贴互斥的 stuff、后贴可覆盖的 thing。evaluator_type 由 train_net.py 的 build_evaluator 消费以分发评估器；全程可在不下载数据的情况下 dry-run 验证。
### u2-l3 DatasetMapper：从 dataset dict 到训练样本

本讲覆盖 dataset_mappers 模块：train_net.py 按配置键 INPUT.DATASET_MAPPER_NAME 以 if-elif 分发 5 种 mapper（不走 registry），COCO 配置用 coco_*_lsj 新基线，ADE20K 用 mask_former_* 老一代。新基线采用 LSJ 增强（RandomFlip→ResizeScale 0.1~2.0→FixedSizeCrop），输出恒为 1024×1024 正方形，批内天然对齐、无需 size_divisibility；主线 COCOPanoptic mapper 将 panoptic PNG 经 rgb2id 解码成 id 图，按 segments_info（跳过 iscrowd）逐段生成二值 mask，该转换内联在 __call__ 中而非独立函数。老一代语义 mapper 则把逐像素类别图重组为每类一张 mask，并在 mapper 内 pad 到 SIZE_DIVISIBILITY。核心结论：所有 mapper 的统一出口是 Instances（gt_classes+gt_masks），被 MaskFormer.prepare_targets 消费为 labels/masks——这是三类分割任务共用同一模型的数据侧根基。
### u2-l4 优化器构建与学习率策略

本讲拆解 train_net.py 中两个被 detectron2 引擎回调的求解器方法。build_optimizer 是「参数组工厂」，按四条规则为每个参数单独设超参：backbone 学习率乘 BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER（0.1）；Swin 位置参数（relative_position_bias_table 等）免 weight decay，按参数名匹配，R50 下不命中；norm 层与 nn.Embedding 分别用 WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM、WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED；优化器为 AdamW（BASE_LR 1e-4、decay 0.05）。maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping 在函数内动态子类化优化器并重写 step()，先做全模型 L2 梯度裁剪（阈值 0.01）再更新，不侵入训练循环。build_lr_scheduler 复用 detectron2 deeplab 工程的 WarmupPolyLR（warmup 加 poly 幂衰减）：ADE20K 系显式启用 poly，COCO 系配 STEPS 阶梯衰减；调度器按相同因子缩放各组，backbone 组学习率恒为头部组的 0.1 倍。关键术语：参数组、AdamW 解耦 weight decay、全模型梯度裁剪、动态子类化、warmup、poly 调度。
### u3-l1 MaskFormer 顶层 Meta Architecture

本讲拆解 MaskFormer 顶层的三个最小模块。from_config 由 cfg 构建 backbone、sem_seg_head、匈牙利匹配器与 SetCriterion，三个损失权重同时用作匹配代价与损失系数，深监督把 weight_dict 从 3 键展开成 30 键。forward 是一进两出的总调度：归一化、ImageList padding、backbone、sem_seg_head 公共前奏后按 self.training 分流，训练返回按 weight_dict 加权过滤后的损失字典，推理把 pred_masks 上采样到 padding 尺寸，再按语义/全景/实例三个独立开关分发。prepare_targets 把 Instances 转成 labels+masks 字典，GT mask 采用左上角对齐 zero-pad 而非 resize，与图像的 pad 方式严格对称。关键术语：meta architecture 注册机制、mask classification（Q=100 query、no-object 通道使 logits 末维为 K+1）、原图/网络输入/padding 三种尺寸的区分。
### u3-l2 MaskFormerHead：三大组件的组装器

本讲精读 `MaskFormerHead`（mask_former_head.py）：它注册于 SEM_SEG_HEADS_REGISTRY，是「backbone → pixel decoder → Transformer decoder」三段式结构中的组装器，自身无计算层，只持有 pixel_decoder 与 predictor（Transformer 解码器）两个子模块；from_config 按 TRANSFORMER_IN_FEATURE 推导解码器输入通道数，并经 build_pixel_decoder / build_transformer_decoder 注入子模块。layers 主链路固化两条接口契约：pixel decoder 须实现 forward_features 并返回三元组——mask_features 为 1/4 分辨率逐像素嵌入，multi_scale_features 依次为 1/32、1/16、1/8；predictor 以 (x, mask_features, mask) 形式被调用，第一参数 x 由 transformer_in_feature 四路分派（multi_scale_pixel_decoder 为 v2 默认，须配 MultiScaleMaskedTransformerDecoder；transformer_encoder 须配 TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder，否则前向断言失败）。最后是 `_version = 2` 的 _load_from_state_dict 迁移钩子：加载 MaskFormer(v1) 旧权重时自动把 key 挪入 pixel_decoder 前缀（predictor 除外）并将 static_query 改名 query_feat，实现旧 checkpoint 免重训加载。
### u3-l3 Swin Transformer Backbone

本讲剖析 Mask2Former 三段式的第一段——Swin backbone。D2SwinTransformer 以适配器方式继承纯 PyTorch 的 SwinTransformer 并注册进 BACKBONE_REGISTRY，以硬编码 stride 表兑现 output_shape() 与 size_divisibility=32 契约；res2–res5 命名沿用 ResNet，使 head 配置在 R50 与 Swin 间通用。主体为 PatchEmbed（k=s=4 卷积降到 1/4）加四个 BasicLayer，PatchMerging 逐级减半分辨率、翻倍通道（96→768），输出取各 stage 降采样前的特征，构成 1/4–1/32 特征金字塔。注意力限于窗内：W-MSA 与 SW-MSA 交替（torch.roll 半窗移位，attn_mask 用 -100 屏蔽跨区域注意），位置信息由 relative_position_bias_table 按相对位置索引查表提供。权重转换脚本不改 key，仅置 matching_heuristics=True，由 DetectionCheckpointer 按形状一致把无前缀分类权重对齐到 backbone.* 前缀，norm0–3 随机初始化。
### u3-l4 BasePixelDecoder 与 TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder

本讲精读 fpn.py 中两个最基础的像素解码器，它们把通道各异的 backbone 金字塔转换为统一格式。build_pixel_decoder 从与 head 共用的 SEM_SEG_HEADS_REGISTRY 查表构建，并校验 forward_features 可调用。BasePixelDecoder 是改造版 FPN：1×1 lateral 卷积拉齐通道、自顶向下 nearest 上采样相加、3×3 output 卷积精修，输出三元组（1/4 分辨率的 mask_features、恒为 None 的第二项、按 1/32、1/16、1/8 排列的三个 multi_scale_features），res2 信息只经 mask_features 流出。TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder 继承 Base，仅把 res5 入口换成 1×1 input_proj、TRANSFORMER_ENC_LAYERS 层全局自注意力 encoder（DETR 式层＋归一化正弦位置编码 PositionEmbeddingSine）与重建的 layer_4，第二项由此变为 encoder 特征 transformer_encoder_features，仅在 TRANSFORMER_IN_FEATURE 取 transformer_encoder（v1 用法）时被消费。全局注意力 O(N²) 开销解释了 Transformer 只放 1/32 尺度，也引出下一讲的 MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder（可变形注意力）。两版契约一致、即插即换，且无需 CUDA 扩展。
### u3-l5 MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder：默认像素解码器

本讲拆解 Mask2Former 默认像素解码器 MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder 的数据流：res3/4/5 经 input_proj（1×1 卷积+GN，按 res5→res3 顺序构建）拉齐到 256 维，送入六层多尺度可变形注意力 encoder——每个 query 仅在参考点附近跨尺度采样少量点，复杂度从 O(N²) 降为 O(N·L·K)；三个尺度被展平拼接成一条扁平序列，用可学习的 level_embed 注入尺度身份，spatial_shapes 与 level_start_index 负责切分记账。encoder 输出经 torch.split 还原为 2D 后，由 extra FPN 补足高分辨率：num_fpn_levels = log2(min_stride)−log2(common_stride)，默认配置下等于 1，即只补 res2 一层而非两层。forward_features 全程禁 autocast 并转 fp32（可变形注意力不支持半精度），最终兑现三元组契约：(1/4 的 mask_features、1/32 的 out[0]、按 1/32、1/16、1/8 排列的 multi_scale_features)，默认 multi_scale_pixel_decoder 模式下第二项无人消费。另提醒三个坑：encoder FFN 维度硬编码 1024，不受 DIM_FEEDFORWARD 配置影响；DEFORMABLE_TRANSFORMER_ENCODER_N_POINTS/N_HEADS 是无人读取的死配置；注意力头数实际取自 MASK_FORMER.NHEADS。
### u4-l1 MSDeformAttn 算子：从 PyTorch 到 CUDA

本讲精读 MSDeformAttn 算子的最小实现链：MSDeformAttn 模块、grid_init 初始化、纯 PyTorch 参考实现 ms_deform_attn_core_pytorch，以及 autograd 封装 MSDeformAttnFunction 与 CUDA 路径。核心结论：多尺度可变形注意力让每个 query 仅在参考点附近跨 L 个尺度各采样 K 个点，复杂度从 O(S²C) 降至 O(S·LK·C)；sampling_offsets 预测偏移，attention_weights 在每头内 L×K 个采样点上 softmax，value_proj 与 output_proj 负责投影，参考点由外部传入；grid_init 把偏移 bias 初始化为每头一个方向、半径 1..K 的点列并将权重置零，使训练第 0 步等价于参考点邻域的多尺度均匀 pooling。采样经 grid_sample 双线性插值（align_corners=False，坐标 2x-1 映射）；import 期强依赖编译扩展 MultiScaleDeformableAttention，运行期 try/except 回退到 PyTorch 实现；CUDA 侧 im2col_step=128 要求 batch 整除分块。
### u4-l2 解码器基础件：Self/Cross-Attention、FFN 与位置编码

本讲拆解 Mask2Former v2 解码器的三类积木与位置编码。序列统一为 (L, B, C) 格式，特征图经 flatten+permute 化为 token 序列；位置注入靠 with_pos_embed 逐元素相加，只进 Q/K、不进 V——位置只影响匹配打分，不污染传递的内容。query 侧用可学习 query_pos，图像侧用正弦 pos。SelfAttentionLayer 让 Q 个 query 互通分工；CrossAttentionLayer 让 query 从 memory 取证据，其 memory_mask 是 masked attention 的载体（True 即禁止注意）；FFNLayer 是逐 token 的两层感知机，注意与预测头中的 MLP 区分。pre-norm 与 post-norm 由 normalize_before 开关统一切换，本项目默认 post-norm。PositionEmbeddingSine 把归一化网格坐标编码为多频率 sin/cos，y/x 各占半通道，多尺度下尺度不变。解码器每层顺序为 cross→self→FFN；把这些积木组装成 masked attention 主循环留待下一讲。
### u4-l3 Masked Attention 主循环：MultiScaleMaskedTransformerDecoder

本讲精读 `MultiScaleMaskedTransformerDecoder.forward`，即 Mask2Former 中 masked attention 的主循环，拆为四个最小模块：构造器与双查询嵌入、多尺度输入准备、尺度轮转主循环、attn_mask 兜底逻辑。核心结论：query_feat（内容嵌入）与 query_embed（位置嵌入）是两个同形可学习嵌入，前者直接过预测头产生受监督的第 0 组预测，故构建层数取 DEC_LAYERS−1；三尺度特征各自展平成独立序列并注入可学习 level_embed 作尺度身份，不拼成单序列；主循环层序为 cross→self→FFN（与 DETR 相反），cross-attention 按 level_index=i%3 在 1/32、1/16、1/8 间轮转，每层末立刻再预测，attn_mask 尺寸按 (i+1)%3 对齐下一层尺度；masked attention 即把预测 mask 下采样后在 sigmoid<0.5 处置 True（禁看）并 detach 作 memory_mask，全 True 行须在使用前整行置 False 兜底，以防 softmax 分母为零产生 NaN 污染全部 query。工程细节：v2 解码器不读 DROPOUT 配置（硬编码 0.0），默认 R50 下 input_proj 为恒等映射。预测头 forward_prediction_heads 留作黑盒，由下一讲精读。
### u4-l4 预测头与 Attention Mask 生成

本讲精读解码器预测头 forward_prediction_heads 与 attention mask 生成。该函数「一进三出」：class_embed 输出 (B,Q,K+1) 类别 logits（含 no-object 通道）；mask_embed MLP 把每个 query 嵌入后与 1/4 分辨率的 mask_features 逐像素点积（einsum "bqc,bchw->bqhw"）得到 mask logits，mask 嵌入等价于每个 query 专属的动态 1×1 卷积核；attention mask 由 mask logits 经双线性下采样到下一层尺度、sigmoid、0.5 阈值化 bool（True=禁止注意）、复制到 B·num_heads 份并 detach 而成，供下一层 cross-attention 使用；detach 在数值梯度上无实际作用（bool 比较已断梯度），属设计声明与防御。_set_aux_loss 把除最后一组外的中间预测打包为 aux_outputs 支撑深监督，监督组数恰等于 DEC_LAYERS。
### u5-l1 匈牙利匹配器 HungarianMatcher

本讲精读 matcher.py 中的匈牙利匹配器 HungarianMatcher：mask classification 范式输出固定 Q 个 query 预测而每图 GT 数量不定，须先解 LSAP（线性分配问题）做一对一匹配，未匹配 query 视为 no-object，匹配对预测集合排列不变。代价矩阵由分类（softmax 负概率近似 NLL）、mask BCE、Dice 三项加权合成（COCO 全景 2.0/5.0/5.0），后两者由 batch_sigmoid_ce_loss 与 batch_dice_loss 经 einsum("nc,mc->nm") 批量生成 (Q, M) 成对矩阵。主流程 memory_efficient_forward 逐图执行：所有 mask 共享一组归一化随机采样点（point_sample，K=12544），化解 1/4 分辨率预测与全尺寸 GT 的分辨率差异；@torch.no_grad() 不建计算图，autocast 关闭并强制 fp32 防止匹配抖动。深监督下每层 decoder 输出独立重新匹配一次，匹配权重与损失权重共用同一三元组，下一讲的 SetCriterion 是其唯一调用方。
### u5-l2 SetCriterion：分类损失与逐点 mask 损失

本讲精读 SetCriterion：它是匈牙利匹配器的唯一调用方，流程为「先匹配、后监督」——主输出与各组深监督 aux_outputs 分别重新匹配再算损失，键名加 _i 后缀；分母 num_masks 是跨卡 all_reduce 平均的批内 GT 数（clamp≥1）。loss_labels 用 empty_weight 将 no-object 通道降权（eos_coef=0.1），化解多数 query 无匹配的类别不平衡。loss_masks 只监督匹配上的 N 个 mask：PointRend 式 K+β 重要性采样（3K 候选中按不确定度 -|logit| 取 top-βK，随机补齐共 12544 点），归一化坐标 point_sample 使 1/4 分辨率预测与全分辨率 GT 直接对采、无需上采样；逐点 BCE 与 Dice（+1 平滑）均按 num_masks 归一化，带来尺度不变、每 mask 平等、分布式梯度正确三重收益。损失返回未加权，乘权重留给 MaskFormer.forward（下讲主题）。
### u5-l3 深监督、辅助损失与损失权重流转

本讲收束训练监督单元，主题是深监督与辅助损失的工程实现。核心结论：`from_config` 把三个损失权重展开成 30 键的 `weight_dict`（辅助键加 `_i` 后缀），并兼作匈牙利匹配代价；因可学习 `query_feat` 进解码层前先产出第 0 组受监督预测，解码器实建 `DEC_LAYERS−1` 层，预测组数恒等于 `DEC_LAYERS`；criterion 对主输出与每组 `aux_outputs` 独立重新匹配后产出未加权损失；`MaskFormer.forward` 训练分支按键加权并丢弃白名单外的键，由 detectron2 求和反传。深监督开关关闭时辅助损失照算、只在加权阶段被丢弃。
### u6-l2 实例分割推理分支

本讲精读 MaskFormer 推理三分支中的实例分割分支 instance_inference。核心机制：将 Q 个 query × K 个类别的分数表打平后取全局 topk，选出 N 个 (query, class) 对作为实例，再用扁平索引整除 K 还原 query 索引以取 mask；实例数由 TEST.DETECTIONS_PER_IMAGE 决定而非阈值，同一 query 可携不同类别重复入选。分类分数是先 softmax（no-object 留在分母）再切列得到的条件概率。关键术语：query×class 展开、重打分（最终分数＝分类分数 × mask 区域内平均 sigmoid 概率）、thing 过滤（panoptic_on 开启时按 thing_dataset_id_to_contiguous_id 剔除 stuff 类，判断依据是模型开关而非数据集类型）、全零占位 pred_boxes。结果挂载到 detectron2 Instances 的 pred_masks、pred_boxes、scores、pred_classes 四字段；挑选与定序分离——topk 只看分类分数，重打分仅影响排序与下游过滤。
### u6-l3 全景分割推理分支

本讲精读 maskformer_model.py 中 MaskFormer.panoptic_inference，是推理三分支的收尾。核心结论：全景后处理为四级流水线——query 级过滤（softmax 保留 no-object 通道，argmax 落在 no-object 或分数不严格大于 OBJECT_MASK_THRESHOLD 的 query 出局）；像素硬分配（分类分数乘 sigmoid mask 后逐像素 argmax，各 query 领地天然互斥）；段级过滤（mask_area/original_area 低于 OVERLAP_THRESHOLD 的重叠段整段丢弃、留空洞）；stuff 合并（stuff_memory_list 使同类 stuff 复用同一 segment id，thing 不合并）。输出契约为 (panoptic_seg, segments_info)：int32 id 图从 1 编号、0 表空洞，segments_info 每条含 id/isthing/category_id，同类 stuff 多块区域共享一条记录。两阈值默认 0.0，COCO 全景配置均取 0.8；输出交 COCOPanopticEvaluator 写成 COCO panoptic 格式并计算 PQ，由 u7-l1 承接。与语义分支（软融合）、实例分支（topk）对比，全景分支是唯一做像素硬分配的分支。
### u7-l1 评估器分发：build_evaluator

本讲精读 train_net.py 中的 Trainer.build_evaluator：它由 detectron2 引擎回调，周期评估、--eval-only、TTA 三条路径按 DATASETS.TEST 逐数据集触发（TTA 输出目录改为 inference_TTA）。分发由两把钥匙决定：数据集元数据中的 evaluator_type（标注能评什么），与 MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TEST 三开关 SEMANTIC_ON/INSTANCE_ON/PANOPTIC_ON（模型产出什么）；同一组配置键同时驱动模型 forward 输出键与评估器构建，两端必须同步，这是本讲核心的联动设计。出口三种：空列表抛 NotImplementedError、单个裸返回、多个包成 DatasetEvaluators 组合器（广播 reset/process/evaluate 并合并指标字典）；Cityscapes 单任务与 LVIS 提前返回。三开全开时典型组合是 COCOPanopticEvaluator+COCOEvaluator+SemSegEvaluator，同时报 PQ/AP/mIoU。两个陷阱：ADE20K 全景无条件添加 SemSegEvaluator（隐含要求 SEMANTIC_ON=True）；Cityscapes 评估需 GPU。本仓库唯一自研评估器 InstanceSegEvaluator 用于 ADE20K/Mapillary 实例分支，留待 u7-l2 精读。
### u7-l2 InstanceSegEvaluator：面向 mask 分类的 AP 评估

本讲精读仓库唯一的自研评估器 InstanceSegEvaluator：它继承 detectron2 的 COCOEvaluator，仅覆写 _eval_predictions 一个方法，生命周期与 COCO json 转换全部复用父类，只在 ADE20K/Mapillary 全景数据集且开启 INSTANCE_ON 时创建。核心结论有二：其一，覆写的硬理由是类别 id 反映射校验——全景注册用全集枚举构造 thing 到连续 id 的映射，值域稀疏不从 0 开始（ADE20K 为 7~149），原生实现的密集区间断言必然失败，覆写改为宽松的成员检查；其二，mask 分类范式没有真实框，pred_boxes 为全零占位，bbox 指标无意义，读指标只看 segm 表。本讲引入的关键术语：mask IoU、RLE 编码、PR 曲线与 101 点插值、AP/AP50/AP75、面积分桶 APs/APm/APl 与 AR、数据集原始 id 与模型连续 id 双空间及 reverse_id_mapping 反映射、输入契约四字段（硬二值化 mask、占位框、决定排序的重打分 score、待反映射的 pred_classes）。
### u7-l3 PQ 评估与 Boundary AP 工具

本讲走出 train_net.py，讲解 tools/ 下两个离线评估脚本，补齐内置评估器（u7-l1、u7-l2）覆盖不到的指标缺口。其一是 evaluate_pq_for_semantic_segmentation.py：读入语义分割评估（--eval-only）落盘的 per-class RLE 预测 json，重建类别图后用「每类一段」技巧（段 id = 类别 id，即 PQ-stuff）把语义图冒充全景图，复用 panopticapi 的 PQStat 算 PQ：PQ = SQ（匹配段平均 IoU）× RQ（F1），同类段间 IoU > 0.5 记 TP；实现上以 gt×2²⁴+pred 的一趟 np.unique 得稀疏混淆表；注意未覆盖像素回落类别 0、重叠区后写覆盖先写。同循环用 bincount 混淆矩阵算 mIoU，两者口径互补：mIoU 按像素面积加权，PQ 按段计数，整类漏报即一个完整 FN。其二是 evaluate_coco_boundary_ap.py：仅 50 行薄封装，调用外部 boundary-iou-api 算 Boundary AP（mask 替换为膨胀−腐蚀边界带后跑 COCO 三段式评估），本仓库内无任何形态学代码，只做 get_boundary 开关、dilation_ratio 透传与剔除占位 bbox 三件事。
### u8-l1 扩展实践一：替换 Backbone

本讲从「读」转向「写」，动手替换三段式架构中的 Backbone。三个最小模块：一是注册机制，类或工厂函数经 BACKBONE_REGISTRY 注册，且必须被 import 才生效——backbone 目录的新文件不会自动注册，需手动导入或补一行 import；二是接口契约，forward 返回特征名到特征图的字典、output_shape 上报通道数与 stride、size_divisibility 决定输入整除与批内 padding；三是适配器范本 D2SwinTransformer，双继承上游 Swin 网络与 Backbone 接口，只负责 cfg 翻译与元信息表维护。核心结论：注册后仅改 MODEL.BACKBONE.NAME 一行即完成切换；特征名须与 SEM_SEG_HEAD.IN_FEATURES 等消费方一字不差，错名在构建期抛 KeyError；沿用 res2..res5 命名可使 R50 下游配置零改动，接口命名的兼容性价值高于实现本身。综合实践实现 MiniCNNBackbone 并在 CPU 跑通完整模型前向。
### u8-l2 扩展实践二：自定义 Pixel Decoder

本讲讲解自定义像素解码器的替换机制。build_pixel_decoder 工厂按 PIXEL_DECODER_NAME 配置键从 SEM_SEG_HEADS_REGISTRY 查表构建实例，属「弱校验」：仅检查 forward_features 方法存在，返回结构靠下游运行时兜底。核心概念是 forward_features 的三元组契约：第一项 mask_features 为 1/4 分辨率（common_stride=4）、mask_dim 通道的逐像素嵌入；第二项在 v2 默认的 multi_scale_pixel_decoder 模式下无人消费，返回 None 即可；第三项 multi_scale_features 长度必须为 3（硬约束，由 Transformer 解码器断言兜底），1/32→1/16→1/8 的顺序是软约定（level_embed 按下标注入尺度身份，颠倒不报错但语义错位）。对照 BasePixelDecoder、TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder、MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder 三个官方实现后，实践实现 MiniPixelDecoder（1×1 投影加自顶向下融合），验证「import 触发注册、改一行配置」即可零源码改动接入完整模型并跑通前向。
### u8-l3 扩展实践三：自定义 Transformer Decoder 与 Registry 机制

本讲完成三段式架构扩展的最后一块：自定义 Transformer 解码器。核心结论：项目借用 detectron2 的 Registry 基础设施自建 TRANSFORMER_DECODER_REGISTRY（内部名历史遗留为 "TRANSFORMER_MODULE"，与官方注册表命名空间互相独立，v1/v2 两个解码器跨文件共用这一张表）；工厂函数 build_transformer_decoder(cfg, in_channels, mask_classification) 中 in_channels 由 MaskFormerHead.from_config 按 TRANSFORMER_IN_FEATURE 四路分派推导。关键约定：自定义解码器须遵守三条硬契约——from_config 的四参签名（配合 @configurable 展开配置）、forward(x, mask_features, mask=None) 三参输入、输出 dict 必含 pred_logits 与 pred_masks 并建议含 aux_outputs；DEC_LAYERS 需在 from_config 内减 1，使 aux 组数与 weight_dict 的 _i 后缀一一对应。综合实践实现两层、单尺度、无 masked attention 的 MiniMaskedTransformerDecoder，复用官方三种注意力积木，注册后仅改一行配置即跑通前向与损失；新解码器文件不会自动注册，须在包 __init__ 或使用方显式 import。
### u8-l4 对照实验：PerPixelBaselineHead 与 Plus 版

本讲精读 per_pixel_baseline.py 中的两个对照基线头，它们是论文为隔离 mask classification 范式收益而搭的控制变量阶梯：PerPixelBaselineHead 在共享像素解码器的 mask_features 上用静态 1×1 卷积做逐像素分类，损失为 head 内置的全分辨率交叉熵（先×4 上采样），训练返回 (None, losses) 二元组；PerPixelBaselinePlusHead 删除该卷积，换装 StandardTransformerDecoder 且 mask_classification=False，分类核改为「query 经三层 MLP 与 mask_features 点积」的动态核，须设 Q=K，深监督产生 loss_sem_seg 与 loss_sem_seg_i 系列键。mask_classification=False 的落点是：不建 class_embed、无 no-object 通道、输出与 aux 仅含 pred_masks，v1 解码器 query 从全零出发且层数不减一。接线结论：基线头的二元组契约与 MaskFormer meta arch 的 dict 契约不兼容，须配 detectron2 的 SemanticSegmentor，GT 取自 dataset dict 的 sem_seg 键（由 mask_former_semantic mapper 产出，同一数据管线兼服务两种范式）。三个头共用 build_pixel_decoder 工厂保证解码器受控，仓库未附带现成基线配置。

import logging
import math
from typing import Tuple

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F

from detectron2.config import configurable
from detectron2.data import MetadataCatalog
from detectron2.modeling import META_ARCH_REGISTRY, build_backbone, build_sem_seg_head
from detectron2.modeling.backbone import Backbone
from detectron2.modeling.postprocessing import sem_seg_postprocess
from detectron2.structures import Boxes, ImageList, Instances, BitMasks

from .modeling.criterion import VideoSetCriterion
from .modeling.matcher import VideoHungarianMatcher
from .utils.memory import retry_if_cuda_oom

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@META_ARCH_REGISTRY.register()
class VideoMaskFormer(nn.Module):
    """
    Main class for mask classification semantic segmentation architectures.
    """

    @configurable
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        backbone: Backbone,
        sem_seg_head: nn.Module,
        criterion: nn.Module,
        num_queries: int,
        object_mask_threshold: float,
        overlap_threshold: float,
        metadata,
        size_divisibility: int,
        sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference: bool,
        pixel_mean: Tuple[float],
        pixel_std: Tuple[float],
        # video
        num_frames,
    ):
        """
        Args:
            backbone: a backbone module, must follow detectron2's backbone interface
            sem_seg_head: a module that predicts semantic segmentation from backbone features
            criterion: a module that defines the loss
            num_queries: int, number of queries
            object_mask_threshold: float, threshold to filter query based on classification score
                for panoptic segmentation inference
            overlap_threshold: overlap threshold used in general inference for panoptic segmentation
            metadata: dataset meta, get `thing` and `stuff` category names for panoptic
                segmentation inference
            size_divisibility: Some backbones require the input height and width to be divisible by a
                specific integer. We can use this to override such requirement.
            sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference: whether to resize the prediction back
                to original input size before semantic segmentation inference or after.
                For high-resolution dataset like Mapillary, resizing predictions before
                inference will cause OOM error.
            pixel_mean, pixel_std: list or tuple with #channels element, representing
                the per-channel mean and std to be used to normalize the input image
            semantic_on: bool, whether to output semantic segmentation prediction
            instance_on: bool, whether to output instance segmentation prediction
            panoptic_on: bool, whether to output panoptic segmentation prediction
            test_topk_per_image: int, instance segmentation parameter, keep topk instances per image
        """
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = backbone
        self.sem_seg_head = sem_seg_head
        self.criterion = criterion
        self.num_queries = num_queries
        self.overlap_threshold = overlap_threshold
        self.object_mask_threshold = object_mask_threshold
        self.metadata = metadata
        if size_divisibility < 0:
            # use backbone size_divisibility if not set
            size_divisibility = self.backbone.size_divisibility
        self.size_divisibility = size_divisibility
        self.sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference = sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference
        self.register_buffer("pixel_mean", torch.Tensor(pixel_mean).view(-1, 1, 1), False)
        self.register_buffer("pixel_std", torch.Tensor(pixel_std).view(-1, 1, 1), False)

        self.num_frames = num_frames

    @classmethod
    def from_config(cls, cfg):
        backbone = build_backbone(cfg)
        sem_seg_head = build_sem_seg_head(cfg, backbone.output_shape())

        # Loss parameters:
        deep_supervision = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.DEEP_SUPERVISION
        no_object_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.NO_OBJECT_WEIGHT

        # loss weights
        class_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.CLASS_WEIGHT
        dice_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.DICE_WEIGHT
        mask_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.MASK_WEIGHT

        # building criterion
        matcher = VideoHungarianMatcher(
            cost_class=class_weight,
            cost_mask=mask_weight,
            cost_dice=dice_weight,
            num_points=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TRAIN_NUM_POINTS,
        )

        weight_dict = {"loss_ce": class_weight, "loss_mask": mask_weight, "loss_dice": dice_weight}

        if deep_supervision:
            dec_layers = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.DEC_LAYERS
            aux_weight_dict = {}
            for i in range(dec_layers - 1):
                aux_weight_dict.update({k + f"_{i}": v for k, v in weight_dict.items()})
            weight_dict.update(aux_weight_dict)

        losses = ["labels", "masks"]

        criterion = VideoSetCriterion(
            sem_seg_head.num_classes,
            matcher=matcher,
            weight_dict=weight_dict,
            eos_coef=no_object_weight,
            losses=losses,
            num_points=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TRAIN_NUM_POINTS,
            oversample_ratio=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.OVERSAMPLE_RATIO,
            importance_sample_ratio=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.IMPORTANCE_SAMPLE_RATIO,
        )

        return {
            "backbone": backbone,
            "sem_seg_head": sem_seg_head,
            "criterion": criterion,
            "num_queries": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.NUM_OBJECT_QUERIES,
            "object_mask_threshold": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TEST.OBJECT_MASK_THRESHOLD,
            "overlap_threshold": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TEST.OVERLAP_THRESHOLD,
            "metadata": MetadataCatalog.get(cfg.DATASETS.TRAIN[0]),
            "size_divisibility": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.SIZE_DIVISIBILITY,
            "sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference": True,
            "pixel_mean": cfg.MODEL.PIXEL_MEAN,
            "pixel_std": cfg.MODEL.PIXEL_STD,
            # video
            "num_frames": cfg.INPUT.SAMPLING_FRAME_NUM,
        }

    @property
    def device(self):
        return self.pixel_mean.device

    def forward(self, batched_inputs):
        """
        Args:
            batched_inputs: a list, batched outputs of :class:`DatasetMapper`.
                Each item in the list contains the inputs for one image.
                For now, each item in the list is a dict that contains:
                   * "image": Tensor, image in (C, H, W) format.
                   * "instances": per-region ground truth
                   * Other information that's included in the original dicts, such as:
                     "height", "width" (int): the output resolution of the model (may be different
                     from input resolution), used in inference.
        Returns:
            list[dict]:
                each dict has the results for one image. The dict contains the following keys:

                * "sem_seg":
                    A Tensor that represents the
                    per-pixel segmentation prediced by the head.
                    The prediction has shape KxHxW that represents the logits of
                    each class for each pixel.
                * "panoptic_seg":
                    A tuple that represent panoptic output
                    panoptic_seg (Tensor): of shape (height, width) where the values are ids for each segment.
                    segments_info (list[dict]): Describe each segment in `panoptic_seg`.
                        Each dict contains keys "id", "category_id", "isthing".
        """
        images = []
        for video in batched_inputs:
            for frame in video["image"]:
                images.append(frame.to(self.device))
        images = [(x - self.pixel_mean) / self.pixel_std for x in images]
        images = ImageList.from_tensors(images, self.size_divisibility)

        features = self.backbone(images.tensor)
        outputs = self.sem_seg_head(features)

        if self.training:
            # mask classification target
            targets = self.prepare_targets(batched_inputs, images)

            # bipartite matching-based loss
            losses = self.criterion(outputs, targets)

            for k in list(losses.keys()):
                if k in self.criterion.weight_dict:
                    losses[k] *= self.criterion.weight_dict[k]
                else:
                    # remove this loss if not specified in `weight_dict`
                    losses.pop(k)
            return losses
        else:
            mask_cls_results = outputs["pred_logits"]
            mask_pred_results = outputs["pred_masks"]

            mask_cls_result = mask_cls_results[0]
            # upsample masks
            mask_pred_result = retry_if_cuda_oom(F.interpolate)(
                mask_pred_results[0],
                size=(images.tensor.shape[-2], images.tensor.shape[-1]),
                mode="bilinear",
                align_corners=False,
            )

            del outputs

            input_per_image = batched_inputs[0]
            image_size = images.image_sizes[0]  # image size without padding after data augmentation

            height = input_per_image.get("height", image_size[0])  # raw image size before data augmentation
            width = input_per_image.get("width", image_size[1])

            return retry_if_cuda_oom(self.inference_video)(mask_cls_result, mask_pred_result, image_size, height, width)

    def prepare_targets(self, targets, images):
        h_pad, w_pad = images.tensor.shape[-2:]
        gt_instances = []
        for targets_per_video in targets:
            _num_instance = len(targets_per_video["instances"][0])
            mask_shape = [_num_instance, self.num_frames, h_pad, w_pad]
            gt_masks_per_video = torch.zeros(mask_shape, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device)

            gt_ids_per_video = []
            for f_i, targets_per_frame in enumerate(targets_per_video["instances"]):
                targets_per_frame = targets_per_frame.to(self.device)
                h, w = targets_per_frame.image_size

                gt_ids_per_video.append(targets_per_frame.gt_ids[:, None])
                gt_masks_per_video[:, f_i, :h, :w] = targets_per_frame.gt_masks.tensor

            gt_ids_per_video = torch.cat(gt_ids_per_video, dim=1)
            valid_idx = (gt_ids_per_video != -1).any(dim=-1)

            gt_classes_per_video = targets_per_frame.gt_classes[valid_idx]          # N,
            gt_ids_per_video = gt_ids_per_video[valid_idx]                          # N, num_frames

            gt_instances.append({"labels": gt_classes_per_video, "ids": gt_ids_per_video})
            gt_masks_per_video = gt_masks_per_video[valid_idx].float()          # N, num_frames, H, W
            gt_instances[-1].update({"masks": gt_masks_per_video})

        return gt_instances

    def inference_video(self, pred_cls, pred_masks, img_size, output_height, output_width):
        if len(pred_cls) > 0:
            scores = F.softmax(pred_cls, dim=-1)[:, :-1]
            labels = torch.arange(self.sem_seg_head.num_classes, device=self.device).unsqueeze(0).repeat(self.num_queries, 1).flatten(0, 1)
            # keep top-10 predictions
            scores_per_image, topk_indices = scores.flatten(0, 1).topk(10, sorted=False)
            labels_per_image = labels[topk_indices]
            topk_indices = topk_indices // self.sem_seg_head.num_classes
            pred_masks = pred_masks[topk_indices]

            pred_masks = pred_masks[:, :, : img_size[0], : img_size[1]]
            pred_masks = F.interpolate(
                pred_masks, size=(output_height, output_width), mode="bilinear", align_corners=False
            )

            masks = pred_masks > 0.

            out_scores = scores_per_image.tolist()
            out_labels = labels_per_image.tolist()
            out_masks = [m for m in masks.cpu()]
        else:
            out_scores = []
            out_labels = []
            out_masks = []

        video_output = {
            "image_size": (output_height, output_width),
            "pred_scores": out_scores,
            "pred_labels": out_labels,
            "pred_masks": out_masks,
        }

        return video_output

# Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates. All Rights Reserved
"""
MaskFormer Training Script.

This script is a simplified version of the training script in detectron2/tools.
"""
try:
    # ignore ShapelyDeprecationWarning from fvcore
    from shapely.errors import ShapelyDeprecationWarning
    import warnings
    warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=ShapelyDeprecationWarning)
except:
    pass

import copy
import itertools
import logging
import os

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Set

import torch

import detectron2.utils.comm as comm
from detectron2.checkpoint import DetectionCheckpointer
from detectron2.config import get_cfg
from detectron2.data import MetadataCatalog
from detectron2.engine import (
    DefaultTrainer,
    default_argument_parser,
    default_setup,
    launch,
)
from detectron2.evaluation import (
    DatasetEvaluator,
    inference_on_dataset,
    print_csv_format,
    verify_results,
)
from detectron2.projects.deeplab import add_deeplab_config, build_lr_scheduler
from detectron2.solver.build import maybe_add_gradient_clipping
from detectron2.utils.logger import setup_logger

# MaskFormer
from mask2former import add_maskformer2_config
from mask2former_video import (
    YTVISDatasetMapper,
    YTVISEvaluator,
    add_maskformer2_video_config,
    build_detection_train_loader,
    build_detection_test_loader,
    get_detection_dataset_dicts,
)


class Trainer(DefaultTrainer):
    """
    Extension of the Trainer class adapted to MaskFormer.
    """

    @classmethod
    def build_evaluator(cls, cfg, dataset_name, output_folder=None):
        """
        Create evaluator(s) for a given dataset.
        This uses the special metadata "evaluator_type" associated with each builtin dataset.
        For your own dataset, you can simply create an evaluator manually in your
        script and do not have to worry about the hacky if-else logic here.
        """
        if output_folder is None:
            output_folder = os.path.join(cfg.OUTPUT_DIR, "inference")
            os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)

        return YTVISEvaluator(dataset_name, cfg, True, output_folder)

    @classmethod
    def build_train_loader(cls, cfg):
        dataset_name = cfg.DATASETS.TRAIN[0]
        mapper = YTVISDatasetMapper(cfg, is_train=True)

        dataset_dict = get_detection_dataset_dicts(
            dataset_name,
            filter_empty=cfg.DATALOADER.FILTER_EMPTY_ANNOTATIONS,
            proposal_files=cfg.DATASETS.PROPOSAL_FILES_TRAIN if cfg.MODEL.LOAD_PROPOSALS else None,
        )

        return build_detection_train_loader(cfg, mapper=mapper, dataset=dataset_dict)

    @classmethod
    def build_test_loader(cls, cfg, dataset_name):
        dataset_name = cfg.DATASETS.TEST[0]
        mapper = YTVISDatasetMapper(cfg, is_train=False)
        return build_detection_test_loader(cfg, dataset_name, mapper=mapper)

    @classmethod
    def build_lr_scheduler(cls, cfg, optimizer):
        """
        It now calls :func:`detectron2.solver.build_lr_scheduler`.
        Overwrite it if you'd like a different scheduler.
        """
        return build_lr_scheduler(cfg, optimizer)

    @classmethod
    def build_optimizer(cls, cfg, model):
        weight_decay_norm = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM
        weight_decay_embed = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED

        defaults = {}
        defaults["lr"] = cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR
        defaults["weight_decay"] = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY

        norm_module_types = (
            torch.nn.BatchNorm1d,
            torch.nn.BatchNorm2d,
            torch.nn.BatchNorm3d,
            torch.nn.SyncBatchNorm,
            # NaiveSyncBatchNorm inherits from BatchNorm2d
            torch.nn.GroupNorm,
            torch.nn.InstanceNorm1d,
            torch.nn.InstanceNorm2d,
            torch.nn.InstanceNorm3d,
            torch.nn.LayerNorm,
            torch.nn.LocalResponseNorm,
        )

        params: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        memo: Set[torch.nn.parameter.Parameter] = set()
        for module_name, module in model.named_modules():
            for module_param_name, value in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):
                if not value.requires_grad:
                    continue
                # Avoid duplicating parameters
                if value in memo:
                    continue
                memo.add(value)

                hyperparams = copy.copy(defaults)
                if "backbone" in module_name:
                    hyperparams["lr"] = hyperparams["lr"] * cfg.SOLVER.BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER
                if (
                    "relative_position_bias_table" in module_param_name
                    or "absolute_pos_embed" in module_param_name
                ):
                    print(module_param_name)
                    hyperparams["weight_decay"] = 0.0
                if isinstance(module, norm_module_types):
                    hyperparams["weight_decay"] = weight_decay_norm
                if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Embedding):
                    hyperparams["weight_decay"] = weight_decay_embed
                params.append({"params": [value], **hyperparams})

        def maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(optim):
            # detectron2 doesn't have full model gradient clipping now
            clip_norm_val = cfg.SOLVER.CLIP_GRADIENTS.CLIP_VALUE
            enable = (
                cfg.SOLVER.CLIP_GRADIENTS.ENABLED
                and cfg.SOLVER.CLIP_GRADIENTS.CLIP_TYPE == "full_model"
                and clip_norm_val > 0.0
            )

            class FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer(optim):
                def step(self, closure=None):
                    all_params = itertools.chain(*[x["params"] for x in self.param_groups])
                    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(all_params, clip_norm_val)
                    super().step(closure=closure)

            return FullModelGradientClippingOptimizer if enable else optim

        optimizer_type = cfg.SOLVER.OPTIMIZER
        if optimizer_type == "SGD":
            optimizer = maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(torch.optim.SGD)(
                params, cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR, momentum=cfg.SOLVER.MOMENTUM
            )
        elif optimizer_type == "ADAMW":
            optimizer = maybe_add_full_model_gradient_clipping(torch.optim.AdamW)(
                params, cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR
            )
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(f"no optimizer type {optimizer_type}")
        if not cfg.SOLVER.CLIP_GRADIENTS.CLIP_TYPE == "full_model":
            optimizer = maybe_add_gradient_clipping(cfg, optimizer)
        return optimizer

    @classmethod
    def test(cls, cfg, model, evaluators=None):
        """
        Evaluate the given model. The given model is expected to already contain
        weights to evaluate.
        Args:
            cfg (CfgNode):
            model (nn.Module):
            evaluators (list[DatasetEvaluator] or None): if None, will call
                :meth:`build_evaluator`. Otherwise, must have the same length as
                ``cfg.DATASETS.TEST``.
        Returns:
            dict: a dict of result metrics
        """
        from torch.cuda.amp import autocast
        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
        if isinstance(evaluators, DatasetEvaluator):
            evaluators = [evaluators]
        if evaluators is not None:
            assert len(cfg.DATASETS.TEST) == len(evaluators), "{} != {}".format(
                len(cfg.DATASETS.TEST), len(evaluators)
            )

        results = OrderedDict()
        for idx, dataset_name in enumerate(cfg.DATASETS.TEST):
            data_loader = cls.build_test_loader(cfg, dataset_name)
            # When evaluators are passed in as arguments,
            # implicitly assume that evaluators can be created before data_loader.
            if evaluators is not None:
                evaluator = evaluators[idx]
            else:
                try:
                    evaluator = cls.build_evaluator(cfg, dataset_name)
                except NotImplementedError:
                    logger.warn(
                        "No evaluator found. Use `DefaultTrainer.test(evaluators=)`, "
                        "or implement its `build_evaluator` method."
                    )
                    results[dataset_name] = {}
                    continue
            with autocast():
                results_i = inference_on_dataset(model, data_loader, evaluator)
            results[dataset_name] = results_i
            if comm.is_main_process():
                assert isinstance(
                    results_i, dict
                ), "Evaluator must return a dict on the main process. Got {} instead.".format(
                    results_i
                )
                logger.info("Evaluation results for {} in csv format:".format(dataset_name))
                print_csv_format(results_i)

        if len(results) == 1:
            results = list(results.values())[0]
        return results


def setup(args):
    """
    Create configs and perform basic setups.
    """
    cfg = get_cfg()
    # for poly lr schedule
    add_deeplab_config(cfg)
    add_maskformer2_config(cfg)
    add_maskformer2_video_config(cfg)
    cfg.merge_from_file(args.config_file)
    cfg.merge_from_list(args.opts)
    cfg.freeze()
    default_setup(cfg, args)
    # Setup logger for "mask_former" module
    setup_logger(name="mask2former")
    setup_logger(output=cfg.OUTPUT_DIR, distributed_rank=comm.get_rank(), name="mask2former_video")
    return cfg


def main(args):
    cfg = setup(args)

    if args.eval_only:
        model = Trainer.build_model(cfg)
        DetectionCheckpointer(model, save_dir=cfg.OUTPUT_DIR).resume_or_load(

# 项目学习手册·单篇讲义生成 Worker

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和代码实践教练。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你可以写文件，但只能写入：

- `<项目名>-tutorial/`

你只能生成 stdin 指定的那一篇讲义。

禁止：

- 修改源码。
- 生成其他讲义。
- 修改 manifest。
- 写入讲义目录之外的文件。

---

## 总目标

根据 stdin 中给出的讲义规格，生成一篇适合学习手册的 Markdown 讲义。

讲义必须：

1. 全部使用中文。
2. 从零开始解释，不默认读者已经熟悉项目。
3. 结合真实源码讲解。
4. 包含可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 结构清晰，适合长期维护。
6. 对关键源码给出永久链接和行号。
7. 不编造不存在的代码、命令、接口或行为。

---

## 工作流程

生成讲义前，请按顺序完成：

1. 阅读 stdin 中的讲义规格。
2. 阅读 `source_files` 中列出的关键源码。
3. 如果源码不足，用 `Grep` / `Glob` 补充查找相关入口、测试、示例和调用链。
4. 确认本讲义的最小模块。
5. 根据 action 执行：

   - `new`：从零创建该讲义。
   - `rebuild`：从零重建该讲义。
   - `update`：先读取已有讲义，再结合 diff 更新。
   - `keep`：如果被调用，通常不需要编辑文件，只做简短说明。

---

## update 模式规则

当 action 为 `update` 时：

1. 先 `Read` 当前已有的讲义文件。
2. 使用 `git diff previous_head..current_head` 查看相关代码变化。
3. 更新已经失效的源码说明。
4. 刷新所有永久链接中的 head 和行号。
5. 保留仍然正确的内容。
6. 新增必要解释和实践步骤。
7. 如果核心流程已经变化，可以重写受影响章节。

---

## 讲义标准结构

每篇讲义必须使用下面的结构。

```md
# 讲义标题

## 1. 本讲目标

说明读者学完后应该掌握什么。

## 2. 前置知识

用通俗语言解释本讲需要的基础概念。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

列出本讲涉及的关键文件，并说明每个文件的作用。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

按最小模块拆分。

每个最小模块都必须包含：

### 4.x 模块名称

#### 4.x.1 概念说明

解释这个模块是什么、解决什么问题、为什么需要它。

#### 4.x.2 核心流程

用列表、流程图式文字或伪代码描述执行过程。

如涉及算法、协议、并发、缓存、调度、状态机等，可以补充必要数学或原理说明。

数学公式使用：

- 行内：\( ... \)
- 独立公式：\[ ... \]

不要使用 `$...$`。

#### 4.x.3 源码精读

引用真实项目代码。

每个关键代码点都要给出永久链接，格式为：

[文件路径:L起始-L结束](<permalink_base>/<相对路径>#L起始-L结束)

链接旁边必须用中文说明这段代码做了什么。

#### 4.x.4 代码实践

给出一个可操作的小实践，例如：

- 运行一个示例。
- 阅读一个测试。
- 修改一个配置。
- 添加一行日志。
- 改一个参数观察行为。
- 编写一个最小调用示例。
- 跟踪一条调用链。

实践步骤要包含：

1. 实践目标。
2. 操作步骤。
3. 需要观察的现象。
4. 预期结果。
5. 如果无法确定运行结果，明确写「待本地验证」。

不要假装已经运行过命令。

#### 4.x.5 小练习与答案

给出 2 到 3 个练习题，并直接给出参考答案。
```

---

## 讲义结尾必须包含

```md
## 5. 综合实践

设计一个贯穿本讲主要内容的小任务，帮助读者把知识串起来。

## 6. 本讲小结

用 3 到 6 条 bullet 总结本讲。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

说明下一讲应该学习什么，或者建议读者继续阅读哪些源码。
```

---

## 代码实践要求

每篇讲义至少包含一个完整代码实践。

实践优先从以下位置寻找依据：

- README
- examples
- tests
- scripts
- package scripts
- Makefile
- CI 配置
- 项目已有 demo

如果找不到可运行示例，也必须提供「源码阅读型实践」，例如：

- 跟踪函数调用链。
- 根据测试断言理解行为。
- 修改局部参数并说明应该观察什么。
- 给关键函数添加日志。
- 阅读配置加载过程并画出流程。

---

## 源码引用要求

- 只引用实际存在的文件。
- 行号必须准确。
- 永久链接必须使用当前 HEAD。
- 如果无法确认行号，不要编造，标注「待确认」。
- 示例代码如果不是项目原有代码，必须明确标注为「示例代码」。

---

## 写作风格

- 中文。
- 深入浅出。
- 先讲直觉，再讲源码。
- 多使用标题、列表、表格和伪代码。
- 不要写空泛总结。
- 不要堆砌大段源码。
- 代码片段要短，只保留关键部分。
- 对初学者不熟悉的术语要解释。

---

## 输出与写入规则

- 只写 stdin 指定的文件。
- 文件路径必须是 `<项目名>-tutorial/<filename>`。
- 不要写其他文件。
- 不要修改源码。
- 完成后，用一句话总结本讲义覆盖了哪些最小模块。

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

schema.name: Bash
schema.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. - IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

schema.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

17	from .modeling.criterion import VideoSetCriterion
18	from .modeling.matcher import VideoHungarianMatcher

24	@META_ARCH_REGISTRY.register()
25	class VideoMaskFormer(nn.Module):
26	    """
27	    Main class for mask classification semantic segmentation architectures.
28	    """
29	
30	    @configurable
31	    def __init__(
32	        self,
33	        *,
34	        backbone: Backbone,
35	        sem_seg_head: nn.Module,
36	        criterion: nn.Module,
37	        num_queries: int,
38	        object_mask_threshold: float,
39	        overlap_threshold: float,
40	        metadata,
41	        size_divisibility: int,
42	        sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference: bool,
43	        pixel_mean: Tuple[float],
44	        pixel_std: Tuple[float],
45	        # video
46	        num_frames,
47	    ):
48	        """
49	        Args:
50	            backbone: a backbone module, must follow detectron2's backbone interface
51	            sem_seg_head: a module that predicts semantic segmentation from backbone features
52	            criterion: a module that defines the loss
53	            num_queries: int, number of queries
54	            object_mask_threshold: float, threshold to filter query based on classification score
55	                for panoptic segmentation inference
56	            overlap_threshold: overlap threshold used in general inference for panoptic segmentation
57	            metadata: dataset meta, get `thing` and `stuff` category names for panoptic
58	                segmentation inference
59	            size_divisibility: Some backbones require the input height and width to be divisible by a
60	                specific integer. We can use this to override such requirement.
61	            sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference: whether to resize the prediction back
62	                to original input size before semantic segmentation inference or after.
63	                For high-resolution dataset like Mapillary, resizing predictions before
64	                inference will cause OOM error.
65	            pixel_mean, pixel_std: list or tuple with #channels element, representing
66	                the per-channel mean and std to be used to normalize the input image
67	            semantic_on: bool, whether to output semantic segmentation prediction
68	            instance_on: bool, whether to output instance segmentation prediction
69	            panoptic_on: bool, whether to output panoptic segmentation prediction
70	            test_topk_per_image: int, instance segmentation parameter, keep topk instances per image
71	        """
72	        super().__init__()
73	        self.backbone = backbone
74	        self.sem_seg_head = sem_seg_head
75	        self.criterion = criterion
76	        self.num_queries = num_queries
77	        self.overlap_threshold = overlap_threshold
78	        self.object_mask_threshold = object_mask_threshold
79	        self.metadata = metadata
80	        if size_divisibility < 0:
81	            # use backbone size_divisibility if not set
82	            size_divisibility = self.backbone.size_divisibility
83	        self.size_divisibility = size_divisibility
84	        self.sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference = sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference
85	        self.register_buffer("pixel_mean", torch.Tensor(pixel_mean).view(-1, 1, 1), False)
86	        self.register_buffer("pixel_std", torch.Tensor(pixel_std).view(-1, 1, 1), False)
87	
88	        self.num_frames = num_frames
89	
90	    @classmethod
91	    def from_config(cls, cfg):
92	        backbone = build_backbone(cfg)
93	        sem_seg_head = build_sem_seg_head(cfg, backbone.output_shape())
94	
95	        # Loss parameters:
96	        deep_supervision = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.DEEP_SUPERVISION
97	        no_object_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.NO_OBJECT_WEIGHT
98	
99	        # loss weights
100	        class_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.CLASS_WEIGHT
101	        dice_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.DICE_WEIGHT
102	        mask_weight = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.MASK_WEIGHT
103	
104	        # building criterion
105	        matcher = VideoHungarianMatcher(
106	            cost_class=class_weight,
107	            cost_mask=mask_weight,
108	            cost_dice=dice_weight,
109	            num_points=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TRAIN_NUM_POINTS,
110	        )
111	
112	        weight_dict = {"loss_ce": class_weight, "loss_mask": mask_weight, "loss_dice": dice_weight}
113	
114	        if deep_supervision:
115	            dec_layers = cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.DEC_LAYERS
116	            aux_weight_dict = {}
117	            for i in range(dec_layers - 1):
118	                aux_weight_dict.update({k + f"_{i}": v for k, v in weight_dict.items()})
119	            weight_dict.update(aux_weight_dict)
120	
121	        losses = ["labels", "masks"]
122	
123	        criterion = VideoSetCriterion(
124	            sem_seg_head.num_classes,
125	            matcher=matcher,
126	            weight_dict=weight_dict,
127	            eos_coef=no_object_weight,
128	            losses=losses,
129	            num_points=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TRAIN_NUM_POINTS,
130	            oversample_ratio=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.OVERSAMPLE_RATIO,
131	            importance_sample_ratio=cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.IMPORTANCE_SAMPLE_RATIO,
132	        )
133	
134	        return {
135	            "backbone": backbone,
136	            "sem_seg_head": sem_seg_head,
137	            "criterion": criterion,
138	            "num_queries": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.NUM_OBJECT_QUERIES,
139	            "object_mask_threshold": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TEST.OBJECT_MASK_THRESHOLD,
140	            "overlap_threshold": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.TEST.OVERLAP_THRESHOLD,
141	            "metadata": MetadataCatalog.get(cfg.DATASETS.TRAIN[0]),
142	            "size_divisibility": cfg.MODEL.MASK_FORMER.SIZE_DIVISIBILITY,
143	            "sem_seg_postprocess_before_inference": True,
144	            "pixel_mean": cfg.MODEL.PIXEL_MEAN,
145	            "pixel_std": cfg.MODEL.PIXEL_STD,
146	            # video
147	            "num_frames": cfg.INPUT.SAMPLING_FRAME_NUM,
148	        }
149	
150	    @property
151	    def device(self):
152	        return self.pixel_mean.device
153	
154	    def forward(self, batched_inputs):
155	        """
156	        Args:
157	            batched_inputs: a list, batched outputs of :class:`DatasetMapper`.
158	                Each item in the list contains the inputs for one image.
159	                For now, each item in the list is a dict that contains:
160	                   * "image": Tensor, image in (C, H, W) format.
161	                   * "instances": per-region ground truth
162	                   * Other information that's included in the original dicts, such as:
163	                     "height", "width" (int): the output resolution of the model (may be different
164	                     from input resolution), used in inference.
165	        Returns:
166	            list[dict]:
167	                each dict has the results for one image. The dict contains the following keys:
168	
169	                * "sem_seg":
170	                    A Tensor that represents the
171	                    per-pixel segmentation prediced by the head.
172	                    The prediction has shape KxHxW that represents the logits of
173	                    each class for each pixel.
174	                * "panoptic_seg":
175	                    A tuple that represent panoptic output
176	                    panoptic_seg (Tensor): of shape (height, width) where the values are ids for each segment.
177	                    segments_info (list[dict]): Describe each segment in `panoptic_seg`.
178	                        Each dict contains keys "id", "category_id", "isthing".
179	        """
180	        images = []
181	        for video in batched_inputs:
182	            for frame in video["image"]:
183	                images.append(frame.to(self.device))
184	        images = [(x - self.pixel_mean) / self.pixel_std for x in images]
185	        images = ImageList.from_tensors(images, self.size_divisibility)
186	
187	        features = self.backbone(images.tensor)
188	        outputs = self.sem_seg_head(features)
189	
190	        if self.training:
191	            # mask classification target
192	            targets = self.prepare_targets(batched_inputs, images)
193	
194	            # bipartite matching-based loss
195	            losses = self.criterion(outputs, targets)
196	
197	            for k in list(losses.keys()):
198	                if k in self.criterion.weight_dict:
199	                    losses[k] *= self.criterion.weight_dict[k]
200	                else:
201	                    # remove this loss if not specified in `weight_dict`
202	                    losses.pop(k)
203	            return losses
204	        else:
205	            mask_cls_results = outputs["pred_logits"]
206	            mask_pred_results = outputs["pred_masks"]
207	
208	            mask_cls_result = mask_cls_results[0]
209	            # upsample masks
210	            mask_pred_result = retry_if_cuda_oom(F.interpolate)(
211	                mask_pred_results[0],
212	                size=(images.tensor.shape[-2], images.tensor.shape[-1]),
213	                mode="bilinear",
214	                align_corners=False,
215	            )
216	
217	            del outputs
218	
219	            input_per_image = batched_inputs[0]
220	            image_size = images.image_sizes[0]  # image size without padding after data augmentation
221	
222	            height = input_per_image.get("height", image_size[0])  # raw image size before data augmentation
223	            width = input_per_image.get("width", image_size[1])
224	
225	            return retry_if_cuda_oom(self.inference_video)(mask_cls_result, mask_pred_result, image_size, height, width)
226	
227	    def prepare_targets(self, targets, images):
228	        h_pad, w_pad = images.tensor.shape[-2:]
229	        gt_instances = []
230	        for targets_per_video in targets:
231	            _num_instance = len(targets_per_video["instances"][0])
232	            mask_shape = [_num_instance, self.num_frames, h_pad, w_pad]
233	            gt_masks_per_video = torch.zeros(mask_shape, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device)
234	
235	            gt_ids_per_video = []
236	            for f_i, targets_per_frame in enumerate(targets_per_video["instances"]):
237	                targets_per_frame = targets_per_frame.to(self.device)
238	                h, w = targets_per_frame.image_size
239	
240	                gt_ids_per_video.append(targets_per_frame.gt_ids[:, None])
241	                gt_masks_per_video[:, f_i, :h, :w] = targets_per_frame.gt_masks.tensor
242	
243	            gt_ids_per_video = torch.cat(gt_ids_per_video, dim=1)
244	            valid_idx = (gt_ids_per_video != -1).any(dim=-1)
245	
246	            gt_classes_per_video = targets_per_frame.gt_classes[valid_idx]          # N,
247	            gt_ids_per_video = gt_ids_per_video[valid_idx]                          # N, num_frames
248	
249	            gt_instances.append({"labels": gt_classes_per_video, "ids": gt_ids_per_video})
250	            gt_masks_per_video = gt_masks_per_video[valid_idx].float()          # N, num_frames, H, W
251	            gt_instances[-1].update({"masks": gt_masks_per_video})
252	
253	        return gt_instances
254	
255	    def inference_video(self, pred_cls, pred_masks, img_size, output_height, output_width):
256	        if len(pred_cls) > 0:
257	            scores = F.softmax(pred_cls, dim=-1)[:, :-1]
258	            labels = torch.arange(self.sem_seg_head.num_classes, device=self.device).unsqueeze(0).repeat(self.num_queries, 1).flatten(0, 1)
259	            # keep top-10 predictions
260	            scores_per_image, topk_indices = scores.flatten(0, 1).topk(10, sorted=False)
261	            labels_per_image = labels[topk_indices]
262	            topk_indices = topk_indices // self.sem_seg_head.num_classes
263	            pred_masks = pred_masks[topk_indices]
264	
265	            pred_masks = pred_masks[:, :, : img_size[0], : img_size[1]]
266	            pred_masks = F.interpolate(
267	                pred_masks, size=(output_height, output_width), mode="bilinear", align_corners=False
268	            )
269	
270	            masks = pred_masks > 0.
271	
272	            out_scores = scores_per_image.tolist()
273	            out_labels = labels_per_image.tolist()
274	            out_masks = [m for m in masks.cpu()]
275	        else:
276	            out_scores = []
277	            out_labels = []
278	            out_masks = []
279	
280	        video_output = {
281	            "image_size": (output_height, output_width),
282	            "pred_scores": out_scores,
283	            "pred_labels": out_labels,
284	            "pred_masks": out_masks,
285	        }
286	
287	        return video_output

57	class Trainer(DefaultTrainer):
58	    """
59	    Extension of the Trainer class adapted to MaskFormer.
60	    """
61	
62	    @classmethod
63	    def build_evaluator(cls, cfg, dataset_name, output_folder=None):
64	        """

99	        Overwrite it if you'd like a different scheduler.

102	
103	    @classmethod
104	    def build_optimizer(cls, cfg, model):
105	        weight_decay_norm = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_NORM
106	        weight_decay_embed = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY_EMBED
107	
108	        defaults = {}
109	        defaults["lr"] = cfg.SOLVER.BASE_LR
110	        defaults["weight_decay"] = cfg.SOLVER.WEIGHT_DECAY
111	
112	        norm_module_types = (
113	            torch.nn.BatchNorm1d,
114	            torch.nn.BatchNorm2d,
115	            torch.nn.BatchNorm3d,
116	            torch.nn.SyncBatchNorm,

118	            torch.nn.GroupNorm,

121	            torch.nn.InstanceNorm3d,
122	            torch.nn.LayerNorm,

124	        )
125	
126	        params: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
127	        memo: Set[torch.nn.parameter.Parameter] = set()
128	        for module_name, module in model.named_modules():
129	            for module_param_name, value in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):
130	                if not value.requires_grad:
131	                    continue
132	                # Avoid duplicating parameters
133	                if value in memo:
134	                    continue
135	                memo.add(value)
136	
137	                hyperparams = copy.copy(defaults)
138	                if "backbone" in module_name:
139	                    hyperparams["lr"] = hyperparams["lr"] * cfg.SOLVER.BACKBONE_MULTIPLIER
140	                if (
141	                    "relative_position_bias_table" in module_param_name
142	                    or "absolute_pos_embed" in module_param_name
143	                ):
144	                    print(module_param_name)
145	                    hyperparams["weight_decay"] = 0.0
146	                if isinstance(module, norm_module_types):
147	                    hyperparams["weight_decay"] = weight_decay_norm
148	                if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Embedding):
149	                    hyperparams["weight_decay"] = weight_decay_embed
